hero.title: Energy Mission CNC Press Brakes
hero.description: Discover precision metal bending solutions from Energy Mission, designed to support accurate sheet metal forming, consistent production quality and efficient industrial manufacturing.

intro.subtitle: Metal Forming Solutions
intro.heading: Energy Mission CNC Press Brake Machines
intro.description: Energy Mission offers a comprehensive range of press brake machines for sheet metal bending and industrial fabrication. From high-speed CNC bending to heavy-duty applications and conventional hydraulic solutions, explore the Optima, Splendid, Efficient, Tandem / Tridem, Magnum, Prudent, NC Press Brake and Hydraulic Press Brake ranges. Contact MTAT Technologies for product availability, machine configurations and technical specifications.

products.title: Optima
products.desc: The Optima Series is designed for precision and productivity in CNC metal bending. Its servo-motor-controlled hydraulic pump system supports accurate Y1 and Y2 axis positioning, while high beam speeds and advanced CNC controls help improve production efficiency. Suitable for manufacturers seeking precise, repeatable bending performance with reduced energy consumption.

products.title: Splendid
products.desc: The Splendid Series combines hydraulic bending power with controlled, consistent operation for precision metal fabrication. Designed for intricate bending applications, it supports smooth machine operation and accurate forming. Its quick-release tooling arrangements help simplify tool changes and reduce changeover time.

products.title: Efficient
products.desc: The Efficient Series focuses on productive and accurate sheet metal bending for industrial manufacturing. Its CNC-controlled bending operations and efficient positioning capabilities help streamline production cycles and maintain consistency across repeat jobs. A practical solution for fabrication businesses handling varied production requirements.

products.title: Tandem / Tridem
products.desc: Energy Mission Tandem / Tridem CNC Press Brakes are designed for applications requiring extended bending lengths and high-capacity metal forming. Synchronized operation of multiple press brakes enables the processing of oversized workpieces and supports demanding industrial fabrication requirements. Suitable configurations depend on the application and machine specifications.

products.title: Magnum
products.desc: The Magnum Series is developed for heavy-duty metal bending applications that demand substantial bending force and robust machine construction. Its heavy-duty design supports the processing of thick metal plates and large components for industrial fabrication. Select the appropriate machine capacity according to material thickness, bending length and production requirements.

products.title: Prudent
products.desc: The Prudent Series offers a compact, practical approach to CNC sheet metal bending. Designed for workshops and manufacturers with specialized production needs, it combines controlled bending operations with a space-conscious machine design. An option for businesses seeking reliable metal forming capabilities suited to their available workspace and production demands.

products.title: NC Press Brake (Front)
products.desc: The NC Press Brake (Front) provides numerically controlled metal bending for manufacturing and fabrication applications. Its front-cylinder configuration offers an alternative within Energy Mission's NC press brake range. A suitable choice for businesses seeking controlled bending operations without requiring every feature of an advanced CNC system. Confirm the available controls and configuration before selection.

products.title: NC Press Brake (Rear)
products.desc: The NC Press Brake (Rear) is designed for controlled sheet metal bending in industrial production environments. Its rear-cylinder configuration offers an alternative for manufacturers evaluating press brake designs for their operational requirements. Contact MTAT Technologies to confirm machine capacity, control options, dimensions and suitability for your application.

products.title: Hydraulic Press Brake
products.desc: Energy Mission Hydraulic Press Brakes provide hydraulic-powered metal forming for a variety of industrial bending applications. Designed to accommodate different fabrication requirements, these machines offer a practical solution for forming sheet metal and metal plates. Available configurations and optional features should be confirmed according to the required bending force, working length and application.

hero.title: Energy Mission Shearing Machines
hero.description: Explore industrial shearing machines from Energy Mission, engineered for efficient sheet metal cutting, accurate sizing and reliable performance across metal fabrication applications.

intro.subtitle: Precision Metal Cutting
intro.heading: Energy Mission Shearing Machines
intro.description: Energy Mission offers a range of industrial shearing solutions for cutting sheet metal and metal plates to the required dimensions. Explore CNC Shearing, NC Shearing and Hydraulic Shearing machines designed for different levels of automation and production requirements. Contact MTAT Technologies to identify the right machine based on material thickness, cutting length, production volume and required control features.

products.title: CNC Shearing Machine
products.desc: Energy Mission CNC Hydraulic Shearing Machines are designed for precise and efficient sheet metal cutting in modern fabrication environments. Computer-controlled operation and programmable positioning options help improve cutting consistency and production workflow. The range includes variable rake angle configurations suited to different sheet thicknesses. Cutting capacity, controller options and available accessories depend on the selected machine configuration.

products.title: NC Shearing Machine
products.desc: Energy Mission NC Shearing Machines provide numerically controlled metal cutting for manufacturing units and fabrication workshops. NC controls can simplify back gauge positioning and repetitive cutting operations, helping operators achieve consistent dimensions with reduced manual adjustment. These machines are suitable for businesses seeking a balance between operational control, productivity and investment. Confirm the available controller, positioning functions and cutting capacity for the selected configuration.

products.title: Hydraulic Shearing Machine
products.desc: Energy Mission Hydraulic Shearing Machines are designed for dependable sheet metal and plate cutting across industrial fabrication applications. The hydraulic guillotine design with variable rake angle supports cutting requirements across different material thicknesses. Features such as adjustable blade clearance and back gauge options can help improve cut quality and dimensional consistency. Machine capacity, control options and accessories should be selected according to the material, thickness and required cutting length.

hero.title: Energy Mission Hydraulic Presses
hero.description: Discover industrial hydraulic press machines from Energy Mission, engineered for controlled pressing, metal forming, deep drawing and precision manufacturing applications.

intro.subtitle: Industrial Metal Forming
intro.heading: Energy Mission Hydraulic Press Machines
intro.description: Energy Mission manufactures hydraulic press machines for a wide range of industrial pressing and metal forming applications. Explore H Frame Press, C Frame Press, Deep Drawing Press and Servo Press configurations designed to meet different workpiece sizes, forming requirements and production needs. Contact MTAT Technologies for assistance with machine selection, available configurations and technical specifications.

products.title: H Frame Press
products.desc: Energy Mission H Frame Hydraulic Presses feature a robust frame structure designed to handle demanding industrial pressing operations. Their rigid construction and adjustable dovetail guides support heavy-duty applications involving metal forming, straightening, assembly and general-purpose pressing. The H-frame design provides a stable working structure for manufacturers handling larger workpieces and substantial pressing loads. Select the machine capacity and configuration according to your application requirements.

products.title: C Frame Press
products.desc: Energy Mission C Frame Hydraulic Presses are designed for pressing applications that require convenient access to the working area. The compact C-shaped frame facilitates workpiece positioning and handling from multiple sides, making the machine suitable for punching, metal forming, assembly and other workshop operations. Different table sizes and throat depths can accommodate varying job requirements. Contact MTAT Technologies to confirm the available capacity and configuration for your application.

products.title: Deep Drawing Press
products.desc: Energy Mission Deep Drawing Hydraulic Presses are designed to transform flat metal sheets into hollow components and formed parts through controlled drawing operations. Available press configurations can include single-action, double-action and triple-action designs to suit different tooling and forming requirements. Hydraulic cushion arrangements and controlled pressing movements support applications where material flow and forming consistency are important. Suitable for manufacturers producing metal housings, containers, cookware components and other deep-drawn parts. Confirm the required press design and tooling configuration before selection.

products.title: Servo Press
products.desc: Energy Mission Servo Presses combine hydraulic pressing technology with servo-driven control for applications requiring controlled pressing performance. Programmable operation can help manage pressing movements and improve process consistency according to the selected configuration. Available designs include H Type, C Type and Piller Type structures, allowing manufacturers to evaluate different machine layouts for their production needs. Suitable applications include precision forming, pressing and industrial assembly. Contact MTAT Technologies to verify the control system, available options and technical specifications.

singhal-press.name: Singhal Press (SEW)
singhal-press.description: Explore SEW mechanical power presses, cross-shaft presses, eccentric-drive presses, link-motion power presses and integrated coil-feeding automation systems for precision metal stamping and industrial manufacturing.

hero.title: SEW Cross Shaft Power Presses
hero.description: Explore precision-engineered cross-shaft power presses designed for metal stamping, blanking, punching and forming operations across industrial manufacturing applications.

intro.subtitle: Precision Metal Stamping
intro.heading: SEW Cross Shaft Press Machines
intro.description: SEW offers cross-shaft power presses in C-frame and ring-frame configurations for a range of metalworking requirements. Explore the SNX, SNX-2, SNXR and SLXR series for applications involving stamping, blanking, punching and forming. Machine capacity, frame configuration and automation options vary by model. Contact MTAT Technologies for technical details and assistance selecting the appropriate press.

products.title: SNX Series Single Point C Frame Cross Shaft Power Presses
products.desc: The SNX Series features a single-point C-frame cross-shaft design for industrial metal stamping and forming. Its precision crankshaft, guided slide, programmable electronic cam system and integrated control features support repeatable production operations. Available capacities range from 25 to 320 tonnes, depending on the model.

products.title: SNX Series Two Point C Frame Cross Shaft Power Presses
products.desc: The SNX-2 Series is a double-crank C-frame cross-shaft power press designed for two-point slide suspension. It supports stamping and forming operations that benefit from distributed slide support and a wider working area. Programmable controls and available automation accessories help manufacturers configure the press for their production requirements.

products.title: SNXR Series Ring Frame Cross Shaft Power Presses
products.desc: The SNXR Series uses a ring-frame structure with a cross-shaft drive arrangement for industrial stamping and forming applications. The frame design supports demanding production operations where rigidity and consistent slide movement are important. Confirm the available tonnage, dimensions and tooling compatibility for the required configuration.

products.title: SLXR Series Link Motion Cross Shaft Geared Ring Frame Press
products.desc: The SLXR Series combines a geared ring-frame construction with cross-shaft and link-motion technology. It is suited to progressive metal forming applications where controlled slide movement, production consistency and resistance to off-centre loading are important. Confirm the required tonnage, stroke, tooling arrangement and available configuration with MTAT Technologies.

hero.title: SEW Two Point Power Presses
hero.description: Discover two-point power presses engineered for stable slide guidance, precision stamping and demanding metal forming applications in industrial production.

intro.subtitle: High-Precision Pressing
intro.heading: SEW Two Point Power Press Machines
intro.description: SEW's two-point press range includes C-frame, H-frame and straight-sided configurations for different stamping and forming requirements. Explore the SNX-2, SXP, SCL-2, HMX, SDC and APH series, along with the AIDA C2-200-2 model listed in the manufacturer's catalogue. Select a press according to the required tonnage, bolster dimensions, stroke, tooling and production process.

products.title: SNX Series Two Point C Frame Cross Shaft Power Presses
products.desc: The SNX-2 Series features a double-crank C-frame design with two-point slide suspension. It is intended for metal stamping and forming operations requiring a wider working area and balanced slide support. The range includes multiple capacities and offers control and automation options according to the selected configuration.

products.title: SXP Series Double Column Two Point H Frame Power Presses
products.desc: The SXP Series is a double-column H-frame mechanical power press with two-point slide suspension. Its stress-relieved fabricated-steel construction, eight-point slide gibbing and pneumatic clutch-brake arrangement support stable operation. The manufacturer lists applications including shallow drawing, forming, blanking and piercing.

products.title: SCL-2 Series H Frame Two Point Eccentric Drive Power Presses
products.desc: The SCL-2 Series is an H-frame two-point power press featuring an eccentric-drive arrangement. It is designed for demanding stamping, blanking and forming applications that benefit from two-point slide support and a rigid frame structure. The manufacturer offers different configurations to accommodate varying production and tooling requirements.

products.title: HMX Series Straight Sided Two Point Link Motion Power Presses
products.desc: The HMX Series is a straight-sided two-point link-motion press developed for progressive die and precision stamping applications. Its rigid frame and widely spaced suspension points help manage off-centre loads. The series supports manufacturing processes such as blanking, bending and shallow drawing, including applications involving precision components.

products.title: SDC Series Straight Sided Double Column Two Point Power Press
products.desc: The SDC Series is a straight-sided, double-column two-point power press intended for industrial stamping and forming. Its two-point configuration provides distributed slide support for suitable tooling and production applications. Confirm the available tonnage, stroke, bolster dimensions and drive configuration with MTAT Technologies.

products.title: APH Series H Frame Two Point High Speed Presses
products.desc: The APH Series is a high-speed H-frame two-point press designed for continuous stamping operations. Its stress-relieved frame, precision slide guidance and dynamic balancing features support stable production at high operating speeds. It is suited to high-volume manufacturing where repeatability, rigidity and consistent stamping quality are important.

products.title: AIDA C2-200-2 Two Point C Frame Cross Shaft Power Press
products.desc: The AIDA C2-200-2 is listed in SEW's catalogue as a two-point C-frame cross-shaft power press. It provides an option for manufacturers evaluating a two-point press configuration for industrial stamping and forming. Confirm the machine's condition, availability, specifications and commercial terms before purchase.

hero.title: SEW Eccentric Drive Power Presses
hero.description: Explore eccentric-drive mechanical power presses designed for industrial blanking, punching, cutting, stamping and metal forming operations.

intro.subtitle: Mechanical Power Presses
intro.heading: SEW Eccentric Drive Press Machines
intro.description: Eccentric-drive power presses convert rotary drive motion into reciprocating slide movement for industrial metalworking. SEW's SCL-1 and SCL-2 series provide single-point and two-point H-frame configurations for different production needs. The COTELLI-130 T is also listed in the manufacturer's used-press catalogue and should be treated as a pre-owned machine.

products.title: SCL-1 Series H Frame Single Point Eccentric Drive Power Presses
products.desc: The SCL-1 Series is an H-frame single-point eccentric-drive power press developed for heavy blanking, forming and stamping. Its symmetrical frame, extended stroke options and guided slide design support demanding metalworking operations. The range is suitable for manufacturers requiring a robust mechanical press for cutting, bending, punching and shallow forming applications.

products.title: SCL-2 Series H Frame Two Point Eccentric Drive Power Presses
products.desc: The SCL-2 Series combines an eccentric-drive mechanism with a two-point H-frame configuration. Designed for industrial stamping, blanking and forming, it provides a rigid working structure and distributed slide support for suitable tooling arrangements. Multiple configurations are available to meet different capacity and production requirements.

products.title: COTELLI-130 T C Frame Mechanical Eccentric Press
products.desc: The COTELLI-130 T is a 130-tonne C-frame mechanical eccentric press listed in SEW's used-press catalogue. Published specifications include a 150 mm adjustable stroke and a 650 × 1,100 mm table. As this is a pre-owned machine listing, confirm current availability, condition, service history and specifications before purchase.

hero.title: SEW Link Motion Power Presses
hero.description: Discover link-motion power presses engineered for progressive die stamping, precision forming and demanding high-productivity metalworking applications.

intro.subtitle: Progressive Die Technology
intro.heading: SEW Link Motion Power Press Machines
intro.description: SEW's link-motion press range includes straight-sided two-point and ring-frame configurations designed for progressive stamping and precision forming. Explore the HMX and SLXR series for applications involving blanking, bending and shallow drawing. Select the appropriate configuration according to the tooling layout, required capacity, material and production rate.

products.title: HMX Series Straight Sided Two Point Link Motion Power Presses
products.desc: The HMX Series is designed for progressive forming and high-precision stamping. Its link-motion mechanism supports controlled slide movement, while the straight-sided frame and widely spaced suspension points help accommodate off-centre loads. Suitable processes include precision blanking, bending and shallow drawing for demanding production applications.

products.title: SLXR Series Link Motion Cross Shaft Geared Ring Frame Press
products.desc: The SLXR Series combines link-motion technology with a geared ring-frame cross-shaft press design. It is intended for progressive metal forming and stamping operations that require controlled slide movement and a rigid press structure. Confirm the required tonnage, tooling arrangement, stroke and machine configuration with MTAT Technologies.

hero.title: SEW Knuckle Joint Presses
hero.description: Explore knuckle joint power presses designed for specialized metal forming and precision stamping applications requiring a dedicated mechanical linkage.

intro.subtitle: Specialized Metal Forming
intro.heading: SEW Knuckle Joint Power Press
intro.description: SEW knuckle joint presses use a mechanical linkage mechanism to deliver a specialized slide-motion profile for suitable forming and stamping applications. The range includes multiple machine capacities, with model selection depending on the required pressing force, stroke, die dimensions and production process. Contact MTAT Technologies for current specifications and application guidance.

products.title: SEW Knuckle Joint Press
products.desc: The SEW Knuckle Joint Press range is designed for specialized industrial pressing and metal forming operations. Its knuckle-link mechanism produces a distinct mechanical motion profile suited to applications that require controlled forming action. Published models include GK-400, GK-630, GK-800, GK-1000, GK-1200, GK-1600 and GK-2500. Confirm model-specific capacity, stroke and operating specifications before selection.

hero.title: SEW Coil Feeding Automation Systems
hero.description: Improve coil handling and press-feeding workflows with integrated decoiling, straightening and servo-feeding solutions designed for industrial sheet metal production.

intro.subtitle: Automated Coil Processing
intro.heading: SEW 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 Automation Lines
intro.description: SEW provides coil-feeding equipment and integrated automation lines for sheet metal processing. The range includes NC servo feeders, 2-in-1 decoiler-cum-straighteners and MAF-series 3-in-1 lines. These systems combine material handling, straightening and feeding functions according to the selected configuration, helping streamline coil processing and supply material to downstream presses. Choose a system based on material width, thickness, coil weight and required feed rate.

products.title: NC Servo Feeder & 2-in-1 Decoiler-cum-Straightener
products.desc: This product combines an NC servo feeder with a decoiler-cum-straightener arrangement for automated coil handling and material feeding. The integrated configuration supports unwinding, straightening and accurately feeding strip material into a press or production line. Select the appropriate setup according to material width, thickness, coil weight and feed requirements.

products.title: MAF3 Series 3-in-1 Automation Line
products.desc: The MAF3 Series is a 3-in-1 coil-processing line identified by SEW for thin-material applications. It integrates coil handling, straightening and feeding functions into a coordinated system. Material thickness, coil capacity, working width and operating speed depend on the selected model and material requirements.

products.title: MAF4 Series 3-in-1 Automation Line
products.desc: The MAF4 Series combines decoiling, straightening and servo feeding in an integrated coil-processing line. The manufacturer lists multiple material-width configurations, allowing the system to be matched to different sheet metal handling requirements. Confirm material thickness, coil weight, line speed and model compatibility before selection.

products.title: MAF6 Series 3-in-1 Automation Line
products.desc: The MAF6 Series is an integrated 3-in-1 coil-processing system for automated decoiling, straightening and feeding. Available configurations accommodate different material widths and thickness requirements. It is intended to support consistent material supply to press and stamping operations while reducing the need for separate material-handling units.

products.title: MAF6G Series 3-in-1 Automation Line
products.desc: The MAF6G Series is a 3-in-1 automation line designed for integrated coil handling, straightening and servo feeding. The manufacturer lists configurations for a range of material widths and thicknesses, with capacity depending on the selected model and material properties. Consult MTAT Technologies to identify the appropriate line for your production requirements.
